policies.text: Building an advanced care pavilion is authorized for providers qualifying for public capital grants.
Hygiene standards authorization is fulfilled if a clinical center reaches a nursing personnel infection control training rate of 80% or higher this year.
Diagnostic service clearance is awarded to laboratories holding a CLIA Laboratory Accreditation.
Medication safety verification is satisfied when a dispensing facility uses an automated prescription auditing system.

Urgent treatment performance certification is granted when an emergency care department records an emergency room wait time of 30 minutes or less last quarter and maintains a nurse-to-patient staffing ratio of at least 0.20.
Care safety compliance is recognized when a healthcare provider retains a HIPAA Safeguards Certification or achieves a nursing personnel infection control training rate of at least 85% this year.
Surgical department expansion approval is issued to any clinic achieving clinical operational status that also maintains an Active Biomedical Waste Handling Permit.
A commercial firm obtains premier partner designation if it maintains an annual equipment maintenance budget of at least $100,000.

A medical facility achieves clinical operational status if it holds a HIPAA Safeguards Certification, or completes staff infection control training for at least 90% of nurses this year, or reports no more than 15 annual safety incidents.
Digital system credentialing is granted to any provider that meets data privacy benchmark standards.
A facility meets data privacy benchmark standards when achieving a yearly patient privacy compliance rating of no less than 80%, or upon holding a HIPAA Safeguards Certification.
Public capital grants are available to medical organizations obtaining institutional expansion authorization that hold an emergency medication reserve stock of 400 units or more.
Long-term care compliance is established when a residential institution provides 24-hour on-duty nursing coverage.

A medical organization receives clinical quality designation if it maintains no more than 20 annual patient safety complaints alongside a facility hygiene rating of at least 90%, or if it possesses a State Quality Excellence Award.
Implementation of unified clinical software is approved for healthcare institutions securing digital system credentialing.
A telecommunications network receives broadcast clearance provided it operates a certified remote monitoring platform with at least 500 active users.
Institutional expansion authorization is awarded if a center obtains urgent treatment performance certification while receiving surgical department expansion approval.
